full_prompt_en: A square X-ray-like digital image presents the left-facing profile of a skull, neck, and upper torso against a smooth dark gray-green background. The head dominates the upper two thirds, with a bright milky-white skull outline, a dark rounded cranial cavity, and fine internal arcs around the eye socket and temple. The nasal bridge, jaw, and teeth are sharply legible along the left side of the frame. Several faint translucent contour loops sweep around the back of the head and chin, giving the profile a sense of layered imaging rather than a single opaque outline. Beneath the jaw, the cervical vertebrae descend in a narrow pale stack, shifting to more complex overlapping bones at the shoulder. The shoulder and upper chest enter from the bottom edge, where lighter skeletal lines show through a dark jacket-like outer shape. A black high collar wraps the neck and partly interrupts the bone structure, adding a solid shadowed band between head and torso. Most of the profile faces left, while the right side of the square remains comparatively open and quiet. The viewpoint is a strict side view, making the shape of the cranium and the repeated teeth and vertebrae easy to follow. Light seems to originate from the translucent forms themselves: their edges glow white and pale mint, with warmer ivory flecks in the neck, while the background has no distinct directional cast shadow. Fine lines vary in brightness and overlap, creating depth through transparency rather than surface texture. The overall composition feels clinical and uncanny, balancing a concentrated luminous profile with broad muted negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形X光质感数字图像把颅骨、颈部和上身的左向侧面置于平滑的深灰绿色背景前。头部主导上方三分之二，有乳白色明亮颅骨轮廓、深色圆润颅腔，以及眼窝和太阳穴周围的细内部弧线。鼻梁、下颌和牙齿沿画面左侧清楚可辨。几道隐约透明轮廓线环绕后脑与下巴，让侧影像多层成像，而非单一不透明外框。下颌以下，颈椎以狭长的浅色序列向下延伸，到肩部变为更复杂的重叠骨骼。肩膀与胸部上缘从底边进入，较浅的骨线透过一片似深色夹克的外层形状显现。黑色高领环绕颈部，并局部切断骨骼结构，在头部和躯干之间形成结实的暗带。侧影整体向左，方形画面的右侧则相对开放安静。视点是严格侧面，因此颅顶形状以及重复的牙齿和椎骨容易追踪。光仿佛来自半透明形体自身：边缘发出白色和淡薄荷色微光，颈部有较暖的象牙色碎点，背景上没有明显定向投影。细线亮度各异并相互重叠，通过透明度而非表面肌理制造纵深。整体构图有临床般又略诡异的气氛，以集中发光的侧影对照宽阔柔暗的留白。
style_prompt_en: A translucent radiographic treatment makes internal linework glow through darker semitransparent masses. Milky white, pale mint, and small ivory highlights sit on a subdued charcoal-green field. Thin curves repeat and overlap around stronger clean contours, producing a layered scanning effect and a slight halo of motion. Edges are brightest at the outer boundary and at dense intersections; central cavities stay deep and muted. The light appears emitted from the forms, so there is little conventional cast shadow or surface grain. A large concentrated silhouette occupies one side while the opposite area remains open, giving the luminous detail room to stand out. The visual effect is analytical, spectral, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 半透明的射线摄影效果让内部线条穿过较暗的半透明体块发光。乳白、淡薄荷色与少量象牙白高光落在柔暗的炭绿底上。细曲线在更强、更干净的轮廓周围重复叠合，形成分层扫描效果和轻微运动光晕。边缘在外界和密集交叉点最明亮；中央空腔保持深暗克制。光仿佛由形体自身发出，因此常规投影和表面颗粒都很少。一处集中的大剪影占据一侧，对面区域开放，使发光细节充分突出。视觉效果理性、幽灵般且含蓄戏剧化。
theme_en: A luminous X-ray-like side view of a skull and upper torso
theme_zh: 发光X光质感的颅骨与上半身侧视图
name: X-ray
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
